.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   A subclass of :exc:`ParsingError`, raised when an indented non-comment
   line is parsed as a continuation of an option without a value. Such
   options are accepted when *allow_no_value* is true. The exception's
   ``source`` identifies the input; ``lineno`` is the one-based line
   number, and ``line`` is the exact offending line, including its
   newline if present. These three values are its constructor arguments.


.. exception:: MissingSectionHeaderError
